comparability_note: All strategies receive identical two-candidate pools treated as already eligible for ranking. The fixture does not exercise real capability/deployment eligibility or adapter execution; this measures ranking logic only.

metric_definitions.abstain_precision: correct abstentions / all predicted abstentions; N/A if no abstentions
metric_definitions.abstain_recall: correct abstentions / all abstain-required cases; N/A if none
metric_definitions.coverage_on_qualified: qualified cases with a selection / all qualified cases
metric_definitions.top1_hit_rate: unique labelled best candidate selected / qualified cases; abstention is a miss
metric_definitions.wrong_route_rate: qualified cases with abstention or wrong selection plus abstain-required cases with any selection / all cases

source_note: All 36 ranking cases and their labels are artificial fixtures. Public WeatherBench 2 score listings are audited separately and are not treated as executable deployment evidence.
